_comment: Selectable starts for the New Game screen, shown as a single row of 7 cards in display order. Each: id, file (res:// start config), title, blurb, description (expanded), tier (green|amber|red -> Beginner-friendly|Average|Challenging badge + hex colour), good_id+good_internal (the goods icon shown on the hex), optional recommended:true for the default. Fact bullets (cash/buildings/loans) are DERIVED from the start config file.

starts.title: Metal Magnate
starts.blurb: Ore into iron, on Stoneshore's coast.
starts.description: Your father swore there was truth in metal, then sold the mill before he could prove it. He left you the mines, the furnace, and a name that lifts every ingot you cast. Strike while the iron's hot.

starts.title: Glass Merchant
starts.blurb: Sand into glass, on Vandel's doorstep.
starts.description: You borrowed heavy to turn Vandel's sand into glass, and fast. Now the debt's due, and glass and fortune crack the same way.

starts.title: Open Field
starts.blurb: A clean slate with a healthy float.
starts.description: £1,500 and nothing else. Survey the map, read the markets, and build exactly the supply chain you want from the ground up. The purest test of an industrialist.

starts.title: Troubled Carmaker
starts.description: An auto business sprawled around Capital Port: two car plants, an engine works, a tyre line, £200 cash, and £500 of debt. Streamline the supply chain or sink under the financing.

starts.title: Semiconductor Turnaround
starts.blurb: One chip fab, one crushing loan.
starts.description: A single upgraded chip fab, £200 in cash, and a brutal £1,000 loan. A high-stakes turnaround: ride the value of silicon and outrun the interest, or be buried by it.

starts.title: Too Many Acquisitions
starts.description: Unrelated plants scattered across the whole map — electrolysers, car lines, circuit boards, windows, a bauxite mine — bought on £1,000 of debt with £200 cash and no plan. Find the focus your predecessor never did.

starts.title: Ambitious Start
starts.description: The leanest possible beginning: £300 and nothing else. Every single decision counts from turn one. For players who want the game on hard mode before the difficulty is even set.
